DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

The clinical picture of fever, autonomic instability, and altered mental status, combined with the initial request for CPK which was not yet available, strongly points to NMS. Although the CPK result was marked "Not Available," the constellation of dilated pupils, tachycardia, hypertension, and irritable/aggressive behavior in a young male is highly suggestive of this condition, often triggered by antipsychotic medications. I recommend immediate cooling measures and discontinuation of any offending agents if they were recently administered.
